bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder March 11, 2021

The Guild of Harwich Artists’ March General Meeting will be held this Saturday, March 13 from 2:00 – 4:00 p.m. via Zoom.

We are meeting a week earlier this month to accommodate attendance at the Saturday, March 20th 1:00 – 5:00 p.m. Chatham Bars Inn ‘Meet the Artist’ Series’ featuring 17 Guild artists.

General meetings are open to the public. If you know of a prospective new member, by all means invite them to join us by passing along the following Zoom link:

https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88034637085

Posted in EVENTS, MONTHLY MEETINGS, WHAT'S NEW
